key_catalyst: Global tech weakness and semiconductor selloff despite solid Taiwan Semi earnings
reasoning: The intraday session saw a moderate -0.85% decline driven by global tech weakness and semiconductor selloffs, notably ignoring solid Taiwan Semi earnings. This reaction highlights persistent institutional rotation out of AI and chips, which remains a live headwind. With the moderate decline failing to fully price in this structural tech fragility, staying long carries material gap-down risk as Asian markets digest the weak sentiment.
